heading_en: Total Amount of Credit Risk-Weighted Assets of Ultimate Designated Parent Companies Adopting the Internal Ratings-Based Approach
summary_ja: 内部格付手法採用最終指定親会社の信用リスク・アセットの額の合計額を、内部格付手法分、標準的手法分、証券化、CVAリスク、中央清算機関関連の合計として定義する。
summary_en: Defines total credit risk-weighted assets as the sum of internal ratings-based amounts, standardized-approach amounts, securitization exposures, CVA risk and central counterparty-related exposures.

sections_en.第三節 第一款: Total Amount of Credit Risk-Weighted Assets of Ultimate Designated Parent Companies Adopting the Internal Ratings-Based Approach

paragraphs: The total amount of credit risk-weighted assets of an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach means the sum of the following amounts. (i) The sum of the following amounts of credit risk-weighted assets calculated by the Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach using the internal ratings-based approach: (a) The amount of credit risk-weighted assets calculated for corporate, etc. exposures and retail exposures (including the amounts of credit risk-weighted assets relating to purchased receivables, lease payments (meaning the lease payments provided in Article 151, paragraph (1)), delivery-versus-payment transactions and non-delivery-versus-payment transactions). (b) The amount of credit risk-weighted assets calculated under Article 144. (c) The amount of credit risk-weighted assets calculated under Article 156-2. (d) The amount of credit risk-weighted assets calculated under Article 156-3. (e) The amount of credit risk-weighted assets calculated under Article 156-4. (f) The amount of credit risk-weighted assets of equity exposures, other assets (meaning the assets provided in Article 156, paragraph (2)) and the estimated residual value in lease transactions. (ii) The total amount of credit risk-weighted assets calculated using the standardized approach, by applying Article 14 (limited to the part relating to item (i)) mutatis mutandis to the portion to which the Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach applies the standardized approach. In this case, the term "Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach" in that Article shall be read as "Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach". (iii) The amount of credit risk-weighted assets relating to securitization exposures calculated as provided in the following Chapter. (iv) The amount obtained by dividing by 8% the CVA risk equivalent amount calculated as provided in Chapter 5-2. (v) The amount of credit risk-weighted assets relating to central counterparty-related exposures provided in Article 14, item (iii), calculated as provided in Chapter 5-3.
